{{Quote|Warning to all spacefarers. Asteroid belt exists in outer orbit. Follow transponder buoys for safe passage. Tampering with buoys a capital offense.|A warning given to spacefarers in the Lazerian system|<ref name="TSoK" />}}
'''Transponder buoys''' were navigational aids that guided [[Starship/Legends|starships]] through hazardous areas. Fixed transponder [[Buoy/Legends|buoys]] in the [[Rokwahl Asteroid Belt]]&mdash;located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Lazerian system/Legends|Lazerian system]]&mdash;allowed starship traffic to pass through the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] unharmed. Tampering with these buoys was a capital offense, as stated by a warning to spacefarers that informed them of the buoys.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Transponder buoys were created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
